maya: planning sync — freeze Optimize toolkit sprint. inbound asks: AcmeHealth needs cache invalidation + TTL controls; Novatek wants quant recommendations to cut cost; ops wants eval-triggered alerts. can we do all?

zack: batching presets + minimal cache UI are doable in one sprint (~2w). quant advisor requires eval infra and offline scoring (~3w).

riya: customer-impact: AcmeHealth pilot blocks on invalidation. recommend cache+batching first, quant in next sprint.

oliver: require a lightweight eval-smoke run during canary for any model-impacting change. store per-route evals (90d) for trend alerts.

sam: UX: TTL dropdown + "Invalidate" button in route settings; tooltip w/ recommended TTLs. explain panel for quant can be deferred.

zack: rough estimates:
- batching presets: 3 dev-days
- cache invalidate API + audit entry: 4 dev-days
- UI + docs: 2 dev-days
- quant advisor + eval infra: ~3w engineering

maya: sprint A scope = batching presets + cache API + TTL UI + audit logs. sprint B = quant advisor + eval-triggered alerts. need acceptance for sprint A.

riya: acceptance (sprint A): presets (low/med/high) applied per-route; POST /routes/{id}/invalidate exists; audit log entry on invalidate; canary w/ AcmeHealth for 72h; no p99 latency regression >10%.

oliver: monitoring gates: p95 latency <= 1.25x baseline; error rate delta < 0.3% over 5m windows; run 10 smoke prompts through canary.

maya: rollout plan: FF -> internal -> AcmeHealth canary -> monitor 72h -> wider alpha. stop conditions: p50 latency regress >15% or error spike >0.5% sustained 10m.

oliver: quant gating metrics (sprint B): mean token logprob delta >0.6 or n-gram overlap drop >3% trigger alerts. tune FP rate to <5%.

zack: blockers: KV quota for durable cache + small schema change for audit logs. fallback: in-process TTL backing for pilot (less durable).

maya: owners: batching=zack; cache API=zack+sam; docs=riya; eval-spec=oliver. I'll update roadmap and schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow 10:00.

deploy-bot: CI build 1779999989 passed on feat/toolkit-lite (11m) :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all — will post roadmap update & customer comms after kickoff :tada:
